official_task_documentation.description: There is a board displaying an image of the target object, a basket, and a conveyor carrying multiple objects. The robot needs to first lift the basket more than 8 cm, identify the target object on the conveyor based on the image shown on the board, pick up the target object, and place it into the basket.

scoring.condition: The target object is not placed into the lifted basket.
The image-specified target object is in the basket and lifted at least 8 cm.
